decisions.quote: Screening titles and abstracts for systematic reviews (SRs) is a labor-intensive and error-prone process. With the advent of large language models (LLMs), there is potential to automate and improve the efficiency of this process. This study aims to develop an LLM-based screening tool and compare its performance with existing LLM models in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and precision.
